$comment: Seeded by INO-118 when the adherence lint was first wired into CI.
Every entry here is a PRE-EXISTING violation that predates the gate, kept green so the
lint can start blocking NEW drift today instead of waiting on a cleanup. This file is a
ratchet, not a parking lot: each waiver names the issue that will delete it, an unused
waiver FAILS the build, and adding one is a visible diff on a reviewed file.
Do not add a waiver to land a component. Fix the violation, or if it needs a token
decision, say so on the owning issue below.
INO-172 — adopt the type scale on pages that hardcode font-size
INO-173 — decide the sub-4px spacing steps (1px/2px/6px/10px) or restyle off them
